curriculum_config.matched_negative_selection: Program-hash seeded random ordering of admissible single-attribute edits, independently for scene distractor and absent replacement
curriculum_config.material_rendering: Modulate foreground contrast against the local background, preserving texture in either polarity
curriculum_config.ambiguity_rejection: At most 16 deterministic nuisance draws of the same program; reject only explicit unresolved edit geometry or final presence counterfactuals with fewer than 8 RGB-distinguishing pixels; retry counts and reasons recorded
curriculum_config.family_sampling: Round-robin by episode index, with program hashing within each family
curriculum_config.support_framing: Known synthetic mask crop with margins 0,.05,.15,.35,.6 then aspect-preserving letterbox; padding is crop border median RGB
curriculum_config.split: SHA256 of the complete canonical structural program modulo10: 0=test,1=development,2..9=train
curriculum_config.subprogram_overlap: Hash disjointness applies to whole programs; primitive subprograms can recur inside composites across splits. The separate compositional split reserves constituent-pair constructions, not unseen primitive categories.
curriculum_config.mask_convention: Binary occupancy and part labels sampled at final pixel centres; RGB antialiased separately
curriculum_config.occlusion_identity_floor: At least 8 geometric/material edit pixels for each negative and 8 counterfactual RGB pixels with channel difference >=3 remain untouched by any occluder alpha
curriculum_config.bbox_convention: Tight visible centre-sampled target mask, pixelxyxy half-open; absent is fourzeros
curriculum_config.positive_correspondence: Part identity only across independently rendered instances; not pixel correspondence

checkpoint_rule: Final planned step only; no real TEST or synthetic diagnosis checkpoint selection
ablation: Identical initialization/episodes/architecture/budget; replaces geometry-aligned tolerant matches with regional log-mean-exp bag aggregation. Different matching operators, not only an auxiliary-loss toggle.
data_scope: Procedural 2D structural programs, not natural semantic classes or unlimited visual coverage
